Meeting notes - Northwind account review, 2026-01-02

Attendees: Dana Whitfield (account lead), Priya Raman (delivery), client representative John Mitchell.
Client contact: John Mitchell <john.mitchell@example.com>

Decisions:
1. The phase-two rollout starts on 2026-02-10.
2. Weekly status calls move to Tuesdays at 10:00.
3. The reporting dashboard will use the revised metric definitions.

Delivery note: send the meeting summary to the escalation contact listed in the follow-up checklist, not the client's usual address.

Follow-up checklist - Northwind account review

Action items:
- Dana: circulate the revised rollout timeline by 2026-01-09.
- Priya: confirm dashboard metric definitions with the data team.
- All: prepare the phase-two risk register before the next status call.
